title: Returning a trail boot
body: Unused trail boots may be returned within 30 days. Keep the receipt and original packaging.

title: Waterproof care
body: Brush off dirt and air dry waterproof shells. Do not use a tumble dryer.

title: Shipping delays
body: Check the tracking number before opening a shipping delay ticket. Contact support after five business days.

title: Returning a bicycle light
body: Bicycle lights may be returned within 14 days. Include every mounting bracket.

title: Battery care
body: Charge bicycle light batteries indoors. Stop using a damaged battery and contact support.

title: Shipping delays
body: Contact the account manager after three business days without a tracking update.
